kicker: Chapter 41 · How this book was made
title: One loop
subtitle: My job in all of this is one loop. Not doing it is a valid decision, with its reason.
alt: A loop of four steps around a centre that reads: small finished pieces beat one big review. One, I read an item. Two, I say what I think, in my own words. Three, I pick a verb from a short list: keep, fix, rewrite, merge, cut, article first, later, not doing it. Four, the editor records my comment word for word, turns the verb into a change in the working copy in the vault, and says where it went.

centre.label: Small finished pieces beat one big review.
centre.detail: a release candidate: a whole book, start to finish, that we could publish and do not yet
